opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are not eligible for tuition fee support, ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial connection), and enrolled in an undergraduate degree course at a Scottish higher education institution for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year, for full‑time undergraduate degree courses in academic year 2026‑27.
